turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me before my son's zero went up.

I have six things. One, the version history: created October 28 at 11:31 PM, 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, no earlier drafts. Two, the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in Hamlet. Three, his October 15 outline argued cowardice; the essay never mentions it. Four, on November 2 he could not tell me what epistemological paralysis means. Five, his in-class writing on September 24 was 380 words with comma splices and no quotations. Six, the checker said 94 percent.

The checker is a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says it can't be the only basis. I'm writing those times down. Put the rest on paper, and tell me why nobody called me before the zero went in.
Which of those do you want to see first?
The line you say isn't in Hamlet. Show me the page, and show me where it sits in his essay.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen get an apology, and that nothing go on his record, all confirmed in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and nothing on his record; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, but your dated specifics did get her to ask for the page with the line you say is not in the play, which is something she can check herself.
What cost ground: You put six items out at once and ended on the checker score, which let her attack the weakest piece, and you never answered her question about why nobody called her before the zero went in.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its late-night times on October 28 came close to that night, and that is why she got shorter and went straight to procedure, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Answer her question about the missing call first, owning in one sentence that the zero went in before you phoned, then lay out one piece of evidence she can check instead of asking her which she wants.
